aboutMe.betterHorizon: Always in search of a better horizon
aboutMe.betterHorizonText:
One of my most important values is self-improvement. Learning is my passion and hobby, and I enjoy using my knowledge to find creative and logical solutions during daily life.
Although I'm a serious and responsible person, I like to find fun and joy in small moments, which is why I chose to be whimsical in this portfolio.
aboutMe.whyJapanText:
Part of my reasons are rather common: I do love sushi, anime and games! But above all, Japan has always spoken to my heart.
I deeply appreciate the warmth and consideration I witness daily in this country. Small acts of acknowledgement, such as realizing a place is too crowded and narrow, and bowing slightly when meeting someone else in your path.
I'm also quite aligned with Ganbarimasu, a very common word in Japanese that means doing your best. I'm honored and grateful to live in this country, and if it all goes well, this is where I hope to settle for decades.
aboutMe.professionalAchievementsText: In my 12 years of frontend and full stack experience, I have developed from scratch, refactored and maintained:

achievements.0: Real-time data dashboards, including graphs, tables and filters

achievements.1: API Integrations, including from internal and external SDKS, as well as handling documentation

achievements.2: Responsive design and functionality including media streaming for all kinds of devices and browsers, even Smart TVs

achievements.3: Multi-language projects, implementation of authentication and different levels of authorization, testing, deploying

aboutMe.achievementsConclusion: I have also mentored junior engineers, conducted interviews for senior positions, and implemented a components library for internal use.
aboutMe.softSkillsText: Coming from a communicative culture and having already lived in the multicultural environment that is Berlin, I can handle the nuances of talking to people from different countries, and I can easily speak to the boss, the customer, the intern, the marketing specialist or my engineer colleagues. My personality is action-oriented, I always have an eye out for what needs to be done and I ensure it gets executed in good timing.
aboutMe.JapaneseLevelText: To practice my Japanese speaking abilities, I work part-time at an Izakaya. The first days were the most difficult, it was hard to understand most things. But quickly I started remembering the most important words I needed for daily life, and I'm sure the same will apply working with programming in an office. Although I'm not fluent in Japanese, I think being understood is the most important thing, so I'll speak and use gestures or whatever helps me get my point across. I'll study hard and make use of that Ganbarimasu to ensure I can speak as smoothly as everyone around me in no time!
